scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/robloxstudio-mcp && npm run build -w packages/robloxstudio-mcp-inspector
scripts.compile:plugin: npm --prefix studio-plugin ci && npm --prefix studio-plugin run build
scripts.build:plugin:inspector: npm run compile:plugin && node scripts/build-plugin.mjs --variant inspector
scripts.build:plugins: npm run compile:plugin && node scripts/build-plugin.mjs && node scripts/build-plugin.mjs --variant inspector
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:plugins
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/core && tsx packages/robloxstudio-mcp/src/index.ts
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint:packages && npm run lint:scripts && npm run lint:tests && npm run lint:evals && npm run lint:plugin
scripts.typecheck:cli: npm run build -w packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/robloxstudio-mcp/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck:core && npm run typecheck:cli && npm run typecheck:inspector && npm run typecheck:plugin && npm run typecheck:evals
scripts.test:fault-injection:10k: npm run build -w packages/core && node --expose-gc scripts/fault-injection-benchmark.mjs
scripts.test:toolchain:integration: npm run build -w packages/core && node scripts/test-toolchain-integration.mjs
scripts.release:check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:all && npm run tools:legacy-report -- --check && npm run docs:check && npm run metadata:check && npm run test:plugin:smoke && npm run test:plugin:installer && npm run test:plugin:runtime && npm run verify-package
scripts.release:check:full: npm run release:check && npm run test:fault-injection:10k
